reviews.before: ChatGPT-3.5 (free version) added to instructional videos vs identical videos only (blank control); ChatGPT is the sole additive difference. Raw operative-test scores 73.12 (SD 10.06) vs 65.54 (SD 12.48) on a 0-100 auto-scored desktop-VR task; mean diff 7.58 points, Welch t(176.24)=4.569, P<.001. N=187 analyzed (192 recruited, 5 excluded at eye-tracking calibration; 94 ChatGPT vs 93 control). Baseline theoretical-knowledge test balanced (41.24 vs 42.03, P=.52). No AI during the test (design inference; the paper does not explicitly state ChatGPT was blocked at test). Cohen's d=0.669, SE=0.150, 95% CI ~0.38-0.96 back-calculated from per-arm means/SDs/n; no author-reported standardized effect. Effect concentrated among low-spatial-ability students (70.20 vs 55.41, P<.001) and absent among high-spatial-ability students (76.58 vs 73.89, P=.22). Secondary outcomes favored ChatGPT: self-efficacy P=.04, learning motivation P=.02, cognitive load via pupil-diameter change 0.137 vs 0.312 P<.001.

No AI during the test (design inference; the paper does not explicitly state ChatGPT was blocked at test).
